title: Binance Futures Will Postpone the Minimum Trade Amount Adjustment of USDⓈ-M SOLUSDT Perpetual Contract
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, The adjustment for the  USDⓈ-M SOLUSDT Perpetual Contract , originally set at 2025-04-02 09:30 (UTC), will be postponed to  2025-04-09 09:30 (UTC) . For More Information : Updates on Minimum Trade Amount for USDⓈ-M SOLUSDT Perpetual Futures Contract (2025-04-02) Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2025-04-01
